descriptions: Designed REST API contracts and database schemas, developing features end-to-end with FastAPI and Next.js.
Investigated, reproduced, and patched critical vulnerabilities, including role-based authorization bypasses and XSS.
Reviewed pull requests and enforced coding standards, improving maintainability across backend and frontend modules.
Built harness workflows to integrate AI agents into the SDLC, improving code generation quality for new modules.
Attended meetings with business partners, testing teams, and teammates to discuss requirements and resolve issues.
Diagnosed and fixed client-side race conditions and state desynchronization during concurrent SaaS data syncs.
Integrated Stripe Checkout and multi-tier subscriptions on the frontend with backend webhook handlers to automate recurring billing.
Designed and consumed REST APIs in Express.js and FastAPI, standardizing data contracts across services.
Configured automated CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI/CD and Docker, deploying staging and production environments to DigitalOcean with Nginx.
Mentored new engineers on coding standards, debugging techniques, and frontend-backend integration to shorten onboarding time.
